provenance.note: Actual captured source. The sealed level30prefix has already rewarded2745and391. Shopping/pickups have full personal quotas and zero acquisition killXP. The separate conversation counter precedes the two real death counters. Original reward facts and every old narrative program are preserved.

planningApproaches.reason: StormwindClassic is a different source map coordinate system, not an alias for provider map1453. Native guide source positions remain verbatim. These separately authored planning approaches use only the exact named friendly giver/recipient or proved encounter NPC positions from the existing pinned catalog; no pixel/map conversion is invented.

directives.text: Talk to Tyrion
Turn in Infiltrating the Castle
Accept Items of Some Consequence
Loot Clara's Fresh Apples on the table
If you still need [Silk Cloth] buy some from the Auction House
Talk to Tyrion
Ensure your party has all turned in Items of Some Consequence before you accept The Attack!
Automatic quest accept has been turned off for this step. Note you may not be able to accept the quest if someone else is in the process of doing it
Turn in Items of Some Consequence
Accept The Attack!
Wait in the center of the courtyard for Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade to arrive. This takes roughly 2 minutes
Kill Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade
Talk to Elling Trias up stairs
Turn in The Attack!
Accept The Head of the Beast
Talk to Master Mathias Shaw
Turn in The Head of the Beast
Accept Brotherhood's End
Talk to Baros Alexston
Turn in Brotherhood's End
Accept An Audience with the King
Talk to Lady Katrana Prestor
Turn in An Audience with the King

limitations: Includes inherited, generated, trace and authored Static corrections; excludes character-specific Dynamic corrections, derived passes and localization.
References are not live-game verification. Spawn coordinates do not establish dungeon path populations.
Creature XP eligibility and outdoor rates are historical planning assumptions; suspected credit proxies stay unresolved, and current dungeon tuning requires a sourced profile.

Missing flags do not imply pooled or independent loot; current Forever behavior is not observed by this import.

Local source-bound seven-item Fishing Trap collection for quest 99127. Each character needs seven Half-Eaten Fish; no per-opening yield, simultaneous node count, respawn time, shared copies or acquisition kill XP is assumed.

Source instructions and full per-character counters still determine pickup tasks.

Additional source-bound object pickups preserve each character's complete quota. Item/object/source identities, not respawn measurements, establish the task. No opening yield, collection duration or acquisition kill XP is inferred.

objectiveText: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.
Speak to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
Speak to Tyrion in Stormwind Castle.
Bring 3 Silk Cloth and 2 of Clara's Fresh Apples to Tyrion in Stormwind.

dungeonKillXpReference.source: Owner-supplied planning range: a level-20 dungeon elite killed by five level-20 players gives 24–30 XP per player. Build and sample context are unverified; other levels use a solo-base and level-weighted-share extrapolation. No further division by five, party bonus or patch bonus.
